[LADP.5.2] **Every slot on every schema commits to one concrete type at
declaration**, and nothing later revises it ([RARC.9.4.2]). `Any` is not a type
name, so the compiler refuses a slot declared `Any` as it refuses any
type that does not resolve ([LGRA.5.7.1]). Adapters have
three strategies, picked per slot, in order of
preference:
